pages.text: Inventory Management$(br2)$(l:arcanearchives:blocks/radiantchest)Radiant Chests$(/l) make use of Quark's inventory search bar, and its Sort, Deposit, Merge, Extract, and Restock buttons.

Items marked as favorites will not be deposited into a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/brazierhoarding)Brazier of Hoarding$(/l) on right click. Favorited items can still be inserted into a Brazier of Hoarding when thrown.
